title: The pointwise hyperbolic circle remainder
statement: Fix a cofinite Fuchsian group \(\Gamma<\operatorname{PSL}_2(\mathbb R)\) and \(z,w\in\mathbb H^2\), and count group elements by \(N_\Gamma(R;z,w)=\#\{\gamma\in\Gamma:d(z,\gamma w)\le R\}\). Thus stabilizer multiplicities are included. Write this count as its full spectral main term (including eigenvalues below \(1/4\)) plus \(E(X;z,w)\), where \(X\asymp e^R\). Is \(E(X;z,w)=O_{\varepsilon,\Gamma,z,w}(X^{1/2+\varepsilon})\) for every \(\varepsilon>0\)? This is an explicitly weakened and qualified reconstruction of the notebook\textquoteright s square-root-remainder line, not its exact wording.
status: As of November 2026, unresolved in this general pointwise form in the searched literature. The 2025 preprint states the conjecture and proves a logarithmic improvement on the classical two-thirds bound for specified Heegner points, not the general square-root exponent \citep[Introduction and Theorem~1.1]{chatzakosetal2025hyperbolic}. The unspecified area-plus-boundary expression in the notebook is not certified as a true asymptotic expansion. The April 2026 preprint \citet[\S1.1, Theorem~1.2]{biro2026localsquare} gives a conditional local-square-mean improvement for the modular group, not a general pointwise bound.
